source: closedLessons() of the persona issues closed as by design on 7 Nov 2026, as lib/agent-closed.mjs wrote them

Settings.text: GitHub row claims "Always on" but is not connected
Settings.why: The row's name is the feature "GitHub · Always on"; the "Not connected" badge and "Set up" button beside it are that feature's state, which is exactly rule settings-3 ("a row names a setting and the value beside it is that setting's state")…

Settings.text: Text size description contradicts selected Large option
Settings.why: The percentage is the real zoom, the description is the choice's own word. On a laptop-size display (width up to 1512, the persona's 1280 window) the Default size is 80%, so Large is 0.8 x 1.25 = 100%. "100%.

Jobs.text: Job row titled by a raw URL
Jobs.why: Add application tracks a link the app cannot read with what it has and then asks for the missing facts in the same dialog: when the answer says "not scored yet" the Job title, Company and description fields open and the same Track it saves…

Jobs.text: Issue banner reports problems although there are no jobs
Jobs.why: The banner on Jobs lists the profile's open items, not per-job ones: Cover letter missing, details to fill in Your details, answers to check in What we learned and search suggestions.

Actions.why: "Not in the end-to-end journey: it never reaches our server." is shown only when siteOffForUser() is true, that is a test run of the app; a person's install never sees it.

Strategy.text: consistency on strategy: Relocation says Not specified but Home base says open to rel
Strategy.why: "Not specified" is an answer, not a missing value, and the search only restricts on "no", so "Not specified" next to a Home base saying "open to relocating within Switzerland" does not make scoring treat the person as not open to relocating…
